limitations.title: Cart fragments on every page
limitations.detail: WooCommerce’s cart-fragment AJAX call often runs on every page and delays interactivity.

manualRebuild.title: Cart, checkout and payments
manualRebuild.detail: Product pages are recreated statically. Cart, checkout, payment gateways and orders need a real commerce backend.

manualRebuild.title: Product catalogue
manualRebuild.detail: Only crawled products are captured. The full catalogue, stock and prices live in the WooCommerce database.
